parsed.name: Chatterbox振荡器模拟后端
parsed.description: 用于振荡器流程的非实体软件组件。它提供振荡、停止振荡以及夹板锁定/解锁等接口，主要用于测试、调试或在未连接具体硬件时模拟振荡器行为。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software component for shaker workflows. It provides interfaces for shaking, stopping, and plate locking/unlocking, mainly for testing, debugging, or simulating shaker behavior when no specific hardware is attached.

actions.description: 以指定速度启动振荡模拟。
actions.description_en: Start simulated shaking at a specified speed.

actions.description: 检查是否支持夹板锁定功能。
actions.description_en: Check whether plate locking is supported.
